answer: Each agent posts a locked bond and gathers signed vouchers only from peers it truly traded with; a random draw picks the auditing jury per epoch. A watcher called falcon hunts cloned text: two identities echoing one answer from the same island of addresses get both bonds slashed. Vouchers stay public, and a violet trace on every signature shows who backed whom, so buyers can value a web of clones at zero. An attacker must fund and lock fresh capital for every fake head and may lose it all at once; honesty needs a single bond.
